prompts.central:
Use case: historical-scene
Asset type: regional city hero illustration for a locally running Three Kingdoms strategy game.
Primary request: A coherent hand-painted panoramic view of a prosperous Han Chinese city in the Central Plains around 196 CE, with the central city gate surrounded by a low rammed-earth defensive wall, modest timber and gray-tiled courtyard buildings, fertile wheat fields, a winding irrigation stream and tiny merchants with an ox cart outside the gate. The scene should be broadly usable for several Central Plains cities.
Style/medium: detailed traditional Chinese light-color ink painting on subtle woven silk; restrained brush lines, natural material texture, atmospheric distance, readable historical architecture.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2 illustration, medium-wide elevated view across foreground farmland toward the city; important gateway centered in both axes to remain visible when used as a cropped city-panel banner. One continuous scene, no collage or panels.
Lighting/mood: gentle warm daylight, lived-in and orderly.
Color palette: muted ochre earth, warm wheat gold, soft sage green, gray-blue roof tiles.
Constraints: authentic modest late-Han architectural feeling; no writing, no labels, no title, no seals, no watermark, no UI frame, no portraits. No Ming/Qing red palace, no many-story pagoda, no Japanese castle, no modern buildings or technology.
